about: The workspace UX tynn.ai and Genie both offer, surface by surface: what a person can DO there, what STATES they see, and the API each action uses. tynn.ai, Genie and genie-cloud each declare against it, and each repo's checks fail when its code and this file disagree. Canonical in Civicognita/shared-schemas, published under the tag workspace-ux/v0.8.0 and never rewritten (genie#1295). Each consumer carries a byte-identical copy beside a pin that records the tag and the sha256 of these bytes.

placeholders.{projectId}: the Tynn project's id (the workspace's project.json tynn.projectId)

api.credential: the Genie pairing token (gpk_), never an agent's MCP key
api.surfaceScope: a surface that names its own scope uses it instead of this one (issues: genie:issue-queue)
api.refusal: 404 for every refusal (no scope, no access, wrong project, role may not write)
api.invalid: 422 naming why: errors.status for a workflow step, errors.claim for a claim or an assignment the project's claim rules refuse, or the field's own key for a body that does not validate

live.about: The board follows Tynn as it changes, by a person or an agent, on the board's own channel and the web board's own events. An event is a doorbell: the client asks what changed since its cursor and applies only that, never re-reading the whole board.
live.web: routes/channels.php project-board.{projectId}: exactly whoever may open the board (page work); the board's events ring there and on project.{projectId}, the channel every project page goes live on (whoever may open any page). The app is signed for the board's channel only, through auth below
live.reconnect: backoff; on every (re)subscription the client asks for the changes since its last cursor before it shows live

states.what: the board is being read
a column with no cards says so
a version opens its stories, a story its tasks, and the person can go back up a level
a drop onto a column the card cannot reach does not move it
holding Shift while dragging lets the person drop anywhere
a refused step shows the reason the state machine gave
a story or task opens its detail (description, acceptance criteria, tasks, features) and the person can edit it there
a new story or task is made in its level's backlog column; the workflow moves it on
a backlog card's Start follows the project's claim mode: off (or already the person's) starts; optional offers Claim + Start or Start; required claims, then starts
a claimed card shows its claimant (a person's initials, or an agent's mark) and its name on hover; the person who holds the claim can release it
a person who may manage the project picks a claimant from the project's eligible list (members and agents, by its claimant policy) and the card is assigned to them
the board follows Tynn as it changes, by a person or an agent, without a reload; a small live icon says so
the link to Tynn dropped: an icon says it is reconnecting, it retries with backoff, and it catches up from its cursor before it shows live again
the workspace has no Tynn project
Genie is not paired with Tynn, or the pairing lacks the board scope

data.selection: story: the story whose slug ?story= names, else the lens's first story; its tasks are shown
data.claims: the board's claim settings for this person (board.data.claims: mode, policy, can_assign), which tynn.ai's page reads from its project; a backlog task's Start follows board.data.claims.start

live.about: The WIP page follows Tynn as the version's stories and tasks change. An event is a doorbell: the client reads the WIP page again, once per burst and one read at a time, as tynn.ai's page reloads its props.
live.web: tynn.ai's WIP page goes live on project.{projectId} (ProjectShell → useProjectChannel), where the board's events also ring. The app hears them on the board's own channel, signed at the board door (board.data.live.auth) for whoever may open the board; a person with the WIP page but not the board (a client) is not signed for it, and the tab's WIP is then not live

states.what: WIP is being read
there is no active version, and WIP says so
Active, Attention and Done lenses, each with its count; the person switches between them
a lens with no stories says so (Attention: nothing needs attention)
the chosen story's title, description and its tasks, the ones in motion first, with how many are done
a story with no tasks says so
the Done lens lists the stories delivered in the version, with their task counts
a backlog task's Start follows the project's claim mode, as on the board
a claimed task shows its claimant
a refused step shows the reason the state machine gave
WIP follows Tynn as it changes, without a reload; a small live icon says so
the link to Tynn dropped: an icon says it is reconnecting, and WIP is read again once it is back
the workspace has no Tynn project
Genie is not paired with Tynn, or the pairing lacks the board scope

data.about: The project's one intake queue: ideas, reports and defects before they become work. Its own pairing scope (genie:issue-queue): genie:issues is filing only, which is all an existing pairing consented to. Reads use the Issues page's gate (page issues) and its own builder; writes use the web write routes' gate (the project) and the web page's own actions and form rules.

filters.unknown: an unknown status or source is the default, never an error

form.intake: no search-first gate: a person filing is looking at the queue (tynn.ai IssueController). Anyone who may see the project may file

triage.what: delete, resolve, discard and convert are offered only on an open issue, and only to a person who may triage it (the project's update authority, IssuePolicy)

convert.to: a story in the version's backlog; the issue's solutions become its tasks

close.github: an issue that came from GitHub is closed there too, with the reason as a comment (tynn.ai#379)

live.about: The queue follows Tynn as issues are filed, edited, converted, closed or deleted, by a person or an agent. An event is a doorbell: the client asks what changed since its cursor and applies only that.
live.web: routes/channels.php project-issues.{projectId}: exactly whoever may open the Issues page (page issues); issue events ring there and on project.{projectId}, where tynn.ai's Issues page goes live (ProjectShell → useProjectChannel). The app is signed for the queue's channel only, through auth below
live.reconnect: backoff; on every (re)subscription the client asks for the changes since its last cursor before it shows live

states.what: the queue is being read
Open, Converted, Resolved, Discarded and All; Open is chosen first
Any source, or only what came from people (feedback)
a search over titles and bodies narrows the queue
no issue matches, and the queue says so and offers a new issue

each issue shows its number, title, a short body, its type (with the type's colour), who raised it when anyone is recorded, its GitHub repo and number when it came from GitHub, and its status when it is not open
an issue opens into its form, with who raised it, on which version and from where
an issue that is gone says so
a new issue: title (required), type, priority, description and features, with the form's defaults
delete, resolve, discard and convert on an open issue, for a person who may triage
convert onto one of the active or accepted versions, chosen from a list
resolve and discard each ask for a reason, which is recorded
a refused step shows the reason Tynn gave (already converted, already closed, a field the form refuses)
the queue follows Tynn as it changes, without a reload; a small live icon says so
the link to Tynn dropped: an icon says it is reconnecting, and the queue catches up once it is back
the workspace has no Tynn project
Genie is not paired with Tynn, or the pairing lacks the issue-queue scope

release.when: every story is done (and there is at least one)

live.about: The VIP lane follows Tynn as its version and stories change. An event is a doorbell: the client reads the VIP lane again, once per burst and one read at a time, as tynn.ai's page reloads its props.
live.web: tynn.ai's VIP page goes live on project.{projectId}, where the board's events also ring; the app hears them on the board's own channel, signed at the board door (board.data.live.auth)

states.what: the VIP lane is being read
no VIP in flight: the lane says what VIP is for
a person who may manage the project starts VIP work with a title and why it cannot wait; anyone else is told who can
the VIP banner: its number, title and task progress, and the lane's columns with their stories
each story's one-click move to its next column
Release is offered only once every story is done, and says why otherwise
VIP versions already dealt with, newest first
a refused step shows Tynn's reason
the lane follows Tynn as it changes, without a reload; a small live icon says so
the link to Tynn dropped: an icon says it is reconnecting, and the lane is read again once it is back
the workspace has no Tynn project
Genie is not paired with Tynn, or the pairing lacks the board scope
